findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are embedded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables directly in the Terraform configuration, which is typically stored in version control. This exposes long-lived AWS credentials to anyone with repository access and bypasses the attached IAM role as the credential source.

The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life Lambda runtime that no longer receives security updates or patches. Running on this unmaintained runtime leaves the function exposed to known, unpatched vulnerabilities.
